description: Use when the user asks how prospective the ground is along a road, track or planned drive. Give the ordered vertices of the route (for example a Mapbox Directions geometry); the line is resampled every `spacing_km` and each sample is scored. Returns the route length, sample count, highest and median score, the distance along the route of the highest score, and the score peaks (hotspots), each with its distance along the route, score, tier, nearest known site and a mapUrl.

points.description: Ordered route vertices (>=2), start to end

spacing_km.description: Sample interval along the route, km (0.2-25)

name: score_route
title: Score prospectivity along a route
